title: Undo confirmation tests that run on every platform
body:
Brings the uncommitted work from 2026-11-08/09 in the old main checkout onto current `main`, keeping only what still applies.

**Kept**
- `undo-confirm-simulated.test.ts` (new, 22 tests): `undo` and `decide undo-confirm` with real Git and an in-memory store, so the GIT-04 confirmation checks run on Windows too. Uses the existing `enableUndoForTests` seam; undo stays disabled in the shipped kernel.
- `undo.test.ts`: two added cases (same-label commit in merged history after preview; same-label vs differently labeled empty commits after preview). Conflicting edits to an existing case kept `main`'s version.
- `model-record.test.ts`: two titles reworded to claim no more than the assertions show.

- `tools/uat/uat.mjs`: the filter stop/kill step now waits until `run.json` holds `pid` and `procStart`. Before, it read the file as soon as the filter's marker appeared, and the filter can start before the kernel writes them (Ubuntu failure on this PR).

**Dropped as superseded**
- README, SECURITY, CONTRIBUTING, plugin README and user-doc warnings. They described cleanup as accepting an unchecked confirmation; `main` now refuses cleanup removal and undo outright and documents that. Merging them would make the docs wrong.
- Tech-spec, `lint-quality` and baseline changes that raised the store ceiling to 60,209; `main` is at 55,863.
- The `readme`/`release-checklist` test additions that checked the dropped doc text.

**Evidence**
- Local (Windows): the 22 simulated tests pass against this branch; typecheck, lint-arch, lint-skills, lint-quality and coverage pass. The `model-record` and `undo.test.ts` cases need Linux/macOS and are unverified until CI runs.
